comments.body:
Plundered from German Mercenaries (Baltic Sea, near Danzig: 4 Battle Pinnace Fleet)

Personaly i never saw this fleet before just in ambush mode.

comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: I've been ambushed by these guys a couple times and beaten them. But they were always one or two pinnaces (I was solo). Do they have to be four to have any chance of plundering the crest? And do I need to be fleeted to be ambushed by four?

comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body: this is also 1 of the crests dropped from 'Valubale crest 'chest at the coliseum, some nice crests dropped from that chest including the jolly roger 'Pirate' crest :)

comments.author: Mei Hua
comments.body: Rashid: U can find this fleet of four near Danzing (but it's rare fleet, u'll have to fight those non rare to spawn this).

comments.author: (Rashid)
comments.body: oh, so the crest dropping fleet is not ambush-only then?

comments.author: Chester
comments.body: Nope, as far as I know. I can confirm that this fleet does spawn near Danzig (4 battle pinnacles with this crest on ships), but I haven't plunder this crest yet :)

comments.body: I offer 1m for to anyone who got me that crest!

comments.body: When all the ones for sale ingame are 30-50m, you look like a retard saying that.

comments.author: Enver
comments.body:
I tried like hell to get one, fought a dozen German mercs and NEVER got it. Then finally was attacked while in a fleet, and the fleet admiral plundered and got one!
The bastard wouldn't let me have it either!

comments.author: Ram3443
comments.body: Anyone got one of these for sale? Very much would like this crest.

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: This crest can also be selected as a reward from Famed Advisor (An election combo)

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: I have been going after the Pilgrim Knight's armour and plundered this crest. Anyone know if this is the same fleet?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If I have read the translation of a blog correctly, there seem to be two fleets in that area, but only one gives this crest, and the other drops the armor.

Blog: mogsan.blog54.fc2.com/blog-entry-244.html

Perhaps you can figure it out with that. I'm not much of a plunder MA expert, so I sadly can help you no further. Cheers.

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: Guilder: thanks for the info. This would seem to confirm that it is, in fact, the same fleet. It also says that the armour "...boasts the second highest difficulty." Insightful as always... thanks again.
